questions.question: With forward biased mode, the p-n junction diode ______.
options: Is one in which width of depletion layer increases
Is one in which potential barrier increases
questions.explanation:
In forward bias, diode conducts current.
So it behaves like a closed switch.
questions.subject: basic-electronics

questions.question: In the reverse biasing of a p-n junction diode ______.
options: The width of the depletion layer decreases
The width of the depletion layer increases
The number of minority charge carriers increase
The number of majority charge carriers increase
questions.answer: The width of the depletion layer increases
questions.correctAnswer: The width of the depletion layer increases
questions.explanation:
Reverse bias increases the depletion layer width.
It blocks normal current flow.
questions.subject: basic-electronics

questions.question: The resistance of a p-n junction in forward bias is ______.
questions.explanation:
Forward bias gives very low resistance.
That is why current can flow easily.
questions.subject: basic-electronics

questions.question: The reason of current flow in p-n junction in forward bias is ______.
questions.explanation:
Forward current is mainly due to diffusion of charge carriers.

questions.question: What is the meaning of doping a semiconductor?

questions.question: For a reverse biased p-n junction ______.
options: P region is positive and the current is due to electrons
P region is positive and the current is due to holes
P region is negative and the current is due to electrons
P region is negative and the current is due to both electrons and holes
questions.answer: P region is negative and the current is due to both electrons and holes
questions.correctAnswer: P region is negative and the current is due to both electrons and holes
questions.explanation:
In reverse bias, p-side is connected to negative supply.
Only a very small current due to minority carriers may flow.
questions.subject: basic-electronics

questions.question: The increase in the width of the depletion region in a p-n junction diode is due to ______.

questions.explanation:
Reverse bias increases depletion width.
Forward bias reduces the barrier and helps conduction.
